name: personal-claude-plugin-marketplace
description: Shared standards for Claude Code, one plugin each, with a steward that docks projects onto them and a base that keeps them working.

plugins.name: universal-clean-code
plugins.description: The clean-code rules measured to change what the model writes: today, three parameters at most.

plugins.name: universal-work-discipline
plugins.description: How to report work done in a place someone else maintains: run the checks the place uses, and never call unverified work done.

plugins.name: craft-development
plugins.description: What careful work means for code: test first, a search for the same defect after a bug fix, and verification with typecheck, tests and lint.

plugins.name: craft-code-review
plugins.description: Structured review of a diff or branch: correctness, tests, and API surface, each finding located by file and line.

plugins.name: craft-shipping
plugins.description: Shipping an app built with AI: ask the milestone before a launch verdict, and in a handoff mark where each statement comes from and never copy a secret value, in an empty folder ask before choosing the stack, and on a live server with no deploy tool back up first and swap by rename.

plugins.name: language-simple-natural-language
plugins.description: English, German and Italian that read as if a person wrote them and that nobody can misread: who acts, the condition before the action, and the few rules only one language needs.

plugins.name: language-conventional-commits
plugins.description: Commit messages in the Conventional Commits format: the type by what a user sees, a marked breaking change, a scope the project uses, an imperative description, and a body that says why.

plugins.name: tools-vue
plugins.description: Vue 3 Composition API conventions for components, reactivity, composables, and templates.

plugins.name: tools-appkit
plugins.description: AppKit conventions for macOS apps in code: starting a bare executable, main-thread rules, key events, borderless windows, and kiosk and fullscreen options.

plugins.name: marketplace-steward
plugins.description: The company's standards, one question away. Docks a project when asked: writes its CLAUDE.md, installs the standards it needs with the base plugin, and tidies rules a standard already holds. Answers which standard covers a task, what one says, and what the setup costs.

plugins.name: marketplace-base
plugins.description: What every docked project runs on: an index of every standard at session start, a guard that keeps the build and the tests green, a collector that files the corrections people make as issues for the curators, and a test-runner and a reviewer agent.

plugins.name: marketplace-curator
plugins.description: The curators' workbench in the marketplace's own repository: turns a lesson, a collected correction or an issue into a checked change to a standard on a pull request, and judges a skill, a plugin or the whole set.
